# ✦ Khethi in Tech

### `Learning. Building. Teaching.`

> **A personal tech journey, documented in public.**

Khethi in Tech is my personal digital home for documenting my journey into technology.

I'm a software engineering student learning, building, breaking, fixing, and teaching along the way. This project brings together my technical journey, projects, learning resources, courses, career lessons, digital products, and everything I'm discovering while finding my place in tech.

**The goal is simple:**

**Learn something → build something → understand it → teach it → share it.**

---

## ◇ What is Khethi in Tech?

Khethi in Tech is more than a portfolio.

It is a **multi-page personal platform** designed to grow alongside my career.

Visitors can explore:

| Section            | What's inside                                  |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------- |
| ✦ Home             | The latest from my journey                     |
| ✎ Blog             | Technical lessons, experiences and reflections |
| ◇ Resources        | Free resources for aspiring techies            |
| $ Make Money       | Practical ways to earn while learning          |
| ▣ Courses          | Course recommendations and reviews             |
| ? Advice           | Beginner-friendly tech and career guidance     |
| ♡ One-on-One       | Personal guidance and support                  |
| ◈ Digital Products | Guides, templates and other resources          |
| ⌘ Portfolio        | Projects I've built                            |
| ○ Meet Millie      | The person behind the code                     |

## ◇ The Philosophy

Technology can feel intimidating when you're standing outside looking in.

There's always another language to learn.

Another framework.

Another certification.

Another acronym that sounds like someone sneezed on a keyboard.

Khethi in Tech is my attempt to make that journey more understandable.

I'm documenting the process **while I'm actually living it**, including the things that work, the things that don't, the things I struggle with, and the things I eventually figure out.

No pretending to know everything.

Just **learning, building and teaching.**

---

## ◇ Design System

The visual identity of Khethi in Tech is built around a simple contrast:

**Black. White. Rainbow.**

The interface uses a clean monochromatic foundation with colourful glow effects to represent the many different paths that exist within technology.

### Light Mode

`Clean · Bright · Colourful`

### Dark Mode

`Deep · Focused · Neon`

The site respects the visitor's system colour preference while also allowing them to manually switch themes.

## ◇ Project Goals

This project serves several purposes simultaneously.

### 01 · Build

Strengthen my frontend development skills by designing and developing a real multi-page website from scratch.

### 02 · Learn

Use the project as an opportunity to learn more about:

* Responsive web development
* Accessibility
* SEO
* JavaScript
* UI architecture
* Performance
* Deployment
* Web standards

### 03 · Teach

Turn things I learn into useful explanations and resources for people who are also trying to get into tech.

### 04 · Document

Create a public record of my journey through software engineering and beyond.

### 05 · Create

Build a platform that can eventually support digital products, educational content, affiliate recommendations and other sustainable income streams.

## ◇ Development Approach

Khethi in Tech is being developed **mobile-first**.

The approach is:

```text
Mobile
  ↓
Tablet
  ↓
Desktop
  ↓
Larger screens
```

Rather than designing a desktop website and squeezing it onto a phone afterwards, the interface is built around smaller screens first and progressively enhanced for larger displays.

---

## ◇ Reusability

One of the goals of this project is to develop a reusable personal web-development foundation.

Common elements such as:

* Navigation
* Footer
* Buttons
* Cards
* Content sections
* Theme controls
* Layout patterns

are designed to be reusable rather than recreated for every page.

The long-term goal is to turn the architecture developed here into a personal starter system for future web projects.

---

## ◇ Accessibility

Accessibility is treated as part of development, not an afterthought.

The project aims to incorporate:

* Semantic HTML
* Keyboard-friendly navigation
* Meaningful labels
* Appropriate colour contrast
* Responsive layouts
* Reduced-motion considerations
* Accessible interactive elements
* Clear content hierarchy

---

## ◇ SEO & Discoverability

Because Khethi in Tech is intended to become a public educational resource, discoverability is part of the architecture.

The project will incorporate:

* Descriptive page titles
* Meta descriptions
* Semantic HTML
* Structured headings
* Internal linking
* Search-friendly URLs
* `robots.txt`
* XML sitemap
* Mobile optimisation
* Useful original content

The aim isn't simply to get search traffic.

It's to make sure that when someone does find the site, **they actually find something useful.**
